newsitem.title: USA: Simon says in Chelsea joint venture deal.
newsitem.headline: Simon says in Chelsea joint venture deal.

text.p: Simon DeBartolo Group Inc said it or an affiliate will purchase 1.4 million shares of Chelsea GCA Realty Inc stock at $35.50 per share.

The transaction is part of a fifty-fifty joint venture between the companies to develop and buy manufacturers' outlet shopping centers with 500,000 square feet or more of gross leasable area in the United States.
The boards of both firms have approved the terms and conditions of the joint venture agreement, they said.

"Under the joint venture agreement, separate partnerships or limited liability companies may be formed with respect to each project. Simon and Chelsea will each own 50 percent of the joint venture and any entities formed with respect to specific projects," the companies said.
Both firms are real estate investment trusts.
